label: Retrospective projection simulation

method.market_evaluation: Reported opening market; never a claim that this simulated pick was placed or saved before kickoff.

limitations: Week 1 unavailable without supported preseason baseline.
Current model applied retrospectively; this is not an untouched out-of-sample test of a model fixed before the season.
Historical injuries, weather, line health and player coverage are not reconstructed; scoring-only simulation.
No calibrated win, ATS or total probabilities. No causal conclusions from scoring alone.

games.unavailable_reason: No prior 2026 scoring history and no verified preseason point baseline.
